item.title: Dublin’s Bucket Reveal New Single “Nonsense”
item.description: Dublin noiseniks Bucket return today with new single, Nonsense, that packs in elements of garage, noise, hardcore and electronic music into a volatile three minutes that simmers with tension before collapsing into something erratic and confrontational.
